reasons.auth: SE Ranking requires an API key passed in the Authorization header (Token YOUR_API_KEY). No other auth methods are documented.
reasons.access: A free 14‑day trial provides an API key immediately after email confirmation, allowing full API and MCP access. Production use requires a paid plan, but the trial is self‑serve.
reasons.mcp: The MCP server is officially documented and available to all plans, enabling conversational queries via AI assistants.
reasons.verdict: Public REST API documentation, free trial credentials, and no additional approval steps make it possible to build a toolkit today.
